label: adaptive-planning-summary
note: Illustrative stated starting points; live provider calls, no user Chart writes.

context.intention: I maintain a consistent workout routine.
context.actualStartingPoint: I exercise sporadically. I can use three 30-minute slots each week for bodyweight exercise at home.
context.destinationDescription: I maintain a consistent workout routine.

analysis.startingPointSummary: Currently exercises sporadically, with availability of three 30-minute home bodyweight exercise slots weekly.
assumptions: User has basic knowledge of bodyweight exercises.
User can allocate three separate 30-minute sessions weekly consistently.
No external equipment or gym access is assumed.

routeDesign.complexityReason: The goal is narrowly focused on establishing and sustaining a consistent workout routine with limited weekly time and no equipment constraints.
routeDesign.countReason: Three waypoints capture initial habit formation, routine stabilization, and sustained consistency as distinct states.

analysis.firstMilestoneEvidence: User completes at least one 30-minute bodyweight workout in a week, showing initial routine engagement.

raw.destination: Maintain a consistent workout routine with three 30-minute bodyweight sessions weekly

waypoints.title: Complete at least one 30-minute bodyweight workout this week
waypoints.rationale: Starting with one workout establishes initial engagement and builds momentum toward consistency.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Complete at least one 30-minute bodyweight workout session at home this week.
requirements: Schedule a 30-minute slot this week for exercise.
Choose a simple bodyweight workout routine suitable for home.
Perform the workout during the scheduled time.

moves.title: Identify and schedule a 30-minute workout slot this week
moves.rationale: Scheduling ensures time is reserved and increases likelihood of follow-through.

moves.title: Select a beginner-friendly bodyweight workout routine
moves.rationale: Choosing an accessible routine reduces barriers to starting.

moves.title: Perform the workout during the scheduled time
moves.rationale: Executing the workout initiates the habit formation.

waypoints.title: Establish a routine of three 30-minute workouts per week for two consecutive weeks
waypoints.rationale: Consistent repetition over two weeks builds a stable workout habit and routine.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Complete three 30-minute bodyweight workout sessions per week for two consecutive weeks.
requirements: Reserve three 30-minute slots weekly for workouts.
Perform all three workouts as scheduled each week for two weeks.
Maintain focus on bodyweight exercises at home.

moves.title: Reserve three 30-minute workout slots weekly
moves.rationale: Consistent scheduling supports routine formation.

moves.title: Perform each scheduled workout session
moves.rationale: Regular execution reinforces habit.

moves.title: Track completion to maintain accountability
moves.rationale: Monitoring progress supports sustained effort.

waypoints.title: Sustain a consistent workout routine with three 30-minute sessions weekly for one month
waypoints.rationale: Sustaining the routine for a month reflects a durable change in energy and daily rhythm.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Maintain three 30-minute bodyweight workout sessions per week consistently for one month.
requirements: Continue scheduling and performing three workouts weekly.
Adapt workouts as needed to maintain engagement and prevent plateau.
Integrate workouts seamlessly into weekly routine.

moves.title: Continue scheduling and completing workouts weekly
moves.rationale: Ongoing practice solidifies the routine.

moves.title: Modify workout difficulty or variety if needed
moves.rationale: Adjustments prevent boredom and support progress.

moves.title: Reflect weekly on workout benefits and routine fit
moves.rationale: Awareness of positive changes reinforces motivation.

suggestedOneMove.title: Identify and schedule a 30-minute workout slot this week
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Starting by reserving time for exercise makes the first step manageable and concrete.

raw.personalizedGuidance: Begin by scheduling one 30-minute bodyweight workout this week to start building your consistent routine.

context.intention: I successfully complete my first half marathon.
context.actualStartingPoint: I run 5 km comfortably twice a week. I can train three days each week. I have never completed a half marathon.
context.destinationDescription: I successfully complete my first half marathon.

analysis.startingPointSummary: Currently running 5 km comfortably twice a week, able to train three days per week, no half marathon completed yet.
assumptions: The user can maintain a consistent training schedule of three days per week.
The user has basic running endurance but no half marathon experience.
The goal is to complete a half marathon, which is 21.1 km.

routeDesign.complexityReason: The goal requires building endurance beyond current 5 km runs, establishing a reliable training base, managing recovery, and completing the event.
routeDesign.countReason: Four waypoints cover establishing a reliable training base, increasing endurance, managing recovery/readiness, and completing the half marathon.

analysis.firstMilestoneEvidence: Running consistently three times a week with increased distance beyond 5 km.

raw.destination: Successfully complete your first half marathon (21.1 km).

waypoints.title: Establish a consistent three-day running routine
waypoints.rationale: Building a reliable training base is essential for endurance improvement and injury prevention.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Run at least three times per week consistently for two consecutive weeks.
requirements: Run three times per week for two consecutive weeks.

moves.title: Schedule three specific days for running in your calendar this week
moves.rationale: Setting fixed days helps create habit consistency.

moves.title: Plan easy runs of 5 km on each scheduled day
moves.rationale: Maintaining comfortable distance builds routine without overexertion.

moves.title: Track your runs to monitor consistency
moves.rationale: Recording runs reinforces commitment and progress.

waypoints.title: Increase running distance to 10-15 km per session
waypoints.rationale: Building endurance to cover longer distances is necessary to approach half marathon length.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Regularly run distances between 10 and 15 km during training sessions for at least two weeks.
requirements: Run 10-15 km per session consistently for two weeks.

moves.title: Add 1-2 km to one run each week until reaching 10 km
moves.rationale: Gradual increase prevents injury and builds endurance.

moves.title: Include one longer run of 12-15 km once per week
moves.rationale: Simulates race distance and builds stamina.

moves.title: Maintain other runs at comfortable pace and distance
moves.rationale: Allows recovery and sustainable progress.

waypoints.title: Develop recovery and readiness habits
waypoints.rationale: Effective recovery supports sustained training and reduces injury risk.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Consistently apply recovery practices after runs for at least two weeks.
requirements: Perform post-run stretching after every run.
Incorporate rest or active recovery days.
Monitor and respond to signs of fatigue or soreness.

moves.title: Learn and practice post-run stretching routines
moves.rationale: Improves flexibility and reduces muscle tightness.

moves.title: Schedule rest or active recovery days between runs
moves.rationale: Allows muscles to repair and adapt.

moves.title: Track energy levels and soreness to adjust training intensity
moves.rationale: Prevents overtraining and injury.

waypoints.title: Complete the half marathon race
waypoints.rationale: Achieving the goal confirms readiness and endurance.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Cross the finish line of a half marathon event.
requirements: Register for a half marathon race.
Complete the race distance of 21.1 km.

moves.title: Register for a half marathon race scheduled in the coming months
moves.rationale: Sets a concrete deadline and motivation.

moves.title: Taper training in the week before the race
moves.rationale: Ensures optimal energy and recovery for race day.

moves.title: Follow race day nutrition and pacing plan
moves.rationale: Supports performance and completion.

suggestedOneMove.title: Schedule three specific days for running in your calendar this week
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Setting fixed days helps create habit consistency.

raw.personalizedGuidance: Focus first on building a consistent three-day running routine to establish a solid training base before increasing distance or intensity.

context.actualStartingPoint: Anchor is launched with 20 paying users. I am the solo developer, with 10 hours a week for growth and no paid advertising budget. I can contact current users and have subscription analytics.

vision.title: A sustainable Anchor business
vision.description: 10,000 paying users who continue using Anchor

analysis.startingPointSummary: Anchor is launched with 20 paying users, solo developer with 10 hours/week, no ad budget, can contact users and access subscription analytics.
assumptions: The user can implement product improvements and outreach within 10 hours weekly.
Paid advertising is not an option; growth relies on organic and retention strategies.
Current analytics provide sufficient insight to identify retention and acquisition levers.

routeDesign.complexityReason: The goal requires distinct achievements: improving retention, establishing repeatable acquisition, scaling paying users, and sustaining growth without paid ads.
routeDesign.countReason: Four meaningful waypoints reflect key stages from current 20 paying users to 10,000 paying users with focus on retention and acquisition.

analysis.firstMilestoneEvidence: Retention improvements and initial repeatable acquisition channel established, increasing paying users beyond 20.

raw.destination: Anchor has 10,000 paying users who continue using the app

waypoints.title: Improve user retention to reduce churn
waypoints.rationale: Retaining existing users is essential to sustainable growth and reduces the need for costly acquisition.
waypoints.completionCriteria:
- Retention rate improved as shown by subscription analytics
- Churn rate decreased compared to baseline
- Feedback collected from current users on retention barriers
- Retention improvements implemented
requirements: Retention rate improved as shown by subscription analytics
Churn rate decreased compared to baseline
Feedback collected from current users on retention barriers
Retention improvements implemented

moves.title: Analyze current churn and retention data from subscription analytics
moves.rationale: Understand baseline retention and identify key drop-off points.

moves.title: Contact current paying users to gather feedback on app experience
moves.rationale: Identify retention barriers and opportunities for improvement.

moves.title: Implement at least one retention improvement based on user feedback
moves.rationale: Address issues that cause churn to improve user retention.

moves.title: Monitor retention metrics weekly to assess impact of changes
moves.rationale: Track progress and adjust strategies as needed.

waypoints.title: Establish a repeatable organic acquisition channel
waypoints.rationale: Reliable user acquisition without paid ads is necessary to grow paying users sustainably.
waypoints.completionCriteria:
- At least one organic acquisition channel identified and tested
- Documented process for acquiring new users through this channel
- Initial new paying users acquired via this channel
- Channel performance tracked regularly
requirements: At least one organic acquisition channel identified and tested
Documented process for acquiring new users through this channel
Initial new paying users acquired via this channel
Channel performance tracked regularly

moves.title: Research potential organic acquisition channels suitable for Anchor
moves.rationale: Identify channels aligned with the product and target audience.

moves.title: Test one promising organic acquisition channel with small campaigns or outreach
moves.rationale: Evaluate channel effectiveness with minimal resource use.

moves.title: Document the acquisition process and key learnings
moves.rationale: Create a repeatable method for user acquisition.

moves.title: Track new paying users acquired through the channel weekly
moves.rationale: Measure channel performance and optimize accordingly.

waypoints.title: Grow paying users to 1,000 through retention and acquisition
waypoints.rationale: Scaling to 1,000 paying users demonstrates product-market fit and growth momentum.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Paying users count reaches 1,000 as shown by subscription analytics

moves.title: Continue improving retention based on ongoing user feedback
moves.rationale: Sustain and increase user retention as the user base grows.

moves.title: Scale successful organic acquisition channels to attract more users
moves.rationale: Increase user inflow without paid advertising.

moves.title: Engage current users to encourage referrals
moves.rationale: Leverage word-of-mouth to grow user base.

moves.title: Monitor subscription analytics weekly to track growth and retention
moves.rationale: Ensure growth is on track and adjust tactics as needed.

waypoints.title: Sustain growth to 10,000 paying users with repeatable processes
waypoints.rationale: A sustainable business requires consistent growth and user retention without reliance on paid ads.
waypoints.completionCriteria: Paying users count reaches 10,000 with stable retention and repeatable acquisition

moves.title: Refine retention strategies to maintain low churn at scale
moves.rationale: Keep users engaged and subscribed as the base grows.

moves.title: Optimize and diversify organic acquisition channels
moves.rationale: Ensure steady inflow of new users through multiple sources.

moves.title: Develop scalable user engagement and referral programs
moves.rationale: Encourage existing users to promote the app sustainably.

moves.title: Regularly review analytics to maintain growth and retention targets
moves.rationale: Adapt strategies based on data to sustain business health.

suggestedOneMove.title: Analyze current churn and retention data from subscription analytics
suggestedOneMove.rationale: Understanding baseline retention is the first step toward reducing churn.

raw.personalizedGuidance: Focus first on improving retention with your current users, then build a repeatable organic acquisition channel before scaling paying users.
